title: Technician Efficiency shares a line's hours by each technician's clocked time
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a fresh test location made for this run, so nothing else is invoiced, credited or clocked there; on the Dashboard, the Technician Efficiency tile on This Week shows no percentage (a grey "-").
  3. You run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  4. A test customer with one contact and one asset that uses that contact (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer 1, contact Dana Test, unit ZZ-101).
  5. Technician 1 is you (Admin ShopView, Time Clock on): in a fresh location you are the technician offered in Add Technician, and you clock time yourself.
  6. Technician 2: a test technician in this run's location, with Time Clock on, whose sign-in you have.
  7. Advisor A: you (Admin ShopView); the Service Advisor in the work order's left panel shows your name by default.
  8. Work order 1 (technician time but nobody clocks it), invoiced, not sent, not paid: Service Advisor Advisor A, one labor line ZZAUTOTEST No clock, Technician 1, $100.00 an hour, Estimated Time 1.00, Tech Time 1.00; nobody clocks in on it. Work order 2 is created later, in the steps.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: create a fresh location for every run (use a new name each time, for example ZZAUTOTEST Quiet plus today's date and a letter): profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name, Address 1, City, State/Province, ZIP/Postal Code, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 > Save & Close. Switch to it: click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. While you are in it, add the labor rate this test uses (rates belong to each location): profile icon > Settings > Labor Rates > New Labor Rate: Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Rate 100, Rate 100) > Save & Close. Check: Dashboard > Technician Efficiency tile > range pill > This Week: it shows no percentage (a grey "-").
  • For 4: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save; on its Contacts tab: New Contact; add an asset (Add beside Asset in the New Work Order window, or the customer's Assets tab) and pick that contact in the asset's Contact field.
  • For 5: nothing to set up. To clock time: on the line's Labor row click Start, then Stop > Clock Out (same browser).
  • For 6: create Technician 2 for this run: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Technician2 plus today's date), an Email you can open, Role Technician, a Department, Location = this run's location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Accept the invitation email, set a password, and sign in as them in a private window when the test needs them.
  • For 7: the Service Advisor is in the work order's left panel; pick another name there for a second advisor.
  • For 8: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); set Service Advisor to Advisor A in the left panel; in the New Line window (> New Line on the Lines tab for each further line): What Are You Doing? ZZAUTOTEST No clock, Add Technician Technician 1, Labor Rate the $100 rate you added in this location (for example ZZAUTOTEST Rate 100), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; nobody clocks in; on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu, set the Technician Efficiency tile's range pill to This Week, and write down what the tile shows.
  2. Create work order 2 for the same customer: Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the customer and its asset > Save, then set Service Advisor and the mileage.
  3. On the Lines tab click New Line: What Are You Doing? "ZZAUTOTEST Shared", Add Technician = Technician 1, Labor Rate = the $100 rate you added in this location (for example ZZAUTOTEST Rate 100), Estimated Time 2.00, Tech Time 2.00, tick Line Approved > Save & Close.
  4. As Technician 1 (yourself), on that line's Labor row click Start, then Stop > Clock Out. Then, in a private window signed in as Technician 2, do the same.
  5. On work order 2 click the three dots > Timesheets (2) and edit the records so Technician 1's runs 2.10 hours (e.g. 8:00 AM to 10:06 AM) and Technician 2's 0.90 hours (e.g. 8:00 AM to 8:54 AM). If they cannot be edited, use the hours shown in Reports > Timesheet Activities in the sums below.
  6. On the line click Story > type a short story > Update, click Complete (finish any Missing Details window), then Mark Reviewed, then Finance > Create Invoice (close the payment dialog without paying).
  7. Work out each share by hand: Technician 1 2.00 x 2.10 / 3.00 = 1.40 hours (70%), Technician 2 2.00 x 0.90 / 3.00 = 0.60 hours (30%). Work order 1's 1.00 hour has no clocked time, so it gives nobody a share.
  8. Work out the tile by hand: (1.40 + 0.60) / (2.10 + 0.90) x 100 = 2.00 / 3.00 x 100 = 66.67%.
  9. Click Dashboard, set Technician Efficiency to This Week and write down the percentage and the line under it.
  10. Click the arrow icon beside "Technician Efficiency" on the tile (its tooltip names the report).
  11. Click the Invoiced tab, make sure the Date control shows This week, and write down Technician 1's and Technician 2's Clocked Hrs, Invoiced Tech Hrs and Efficiency.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1, with only work order 1 invoiced and no clocked time: the tile headline reads a single grey hyphen "-", not "0.00%", not blank and not an error.
  • After work order 2: the tile reads 66.67% and the line under it reads "2.00 Invoiced Tech Hrs / 3.00 Clocked". Work order 1's unclocked hour adds nothing and causes no error or endless figure.
  • On the Invoiced tab Technician 1 shows Clocked Hrs 2.10, Invoiced Tech Hrs 1.40, Efficiency 66.67%, and Technician 2 shows 0.90, 0.60 and 66.67%: the line's 2.00 hours are shared 70 / 30 by clocked time.
  • The tile's 66.67% equals the report for the same week.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (S3); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S3 (S3-R2 Technician Efficiency row, S3-E3, S3-R1). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, captured 2026-09-28) used for on-screen labels and navigation only: boards 06_TechEff_After, 12_technician-efficiency_After. Design canvas row 15 (15_Empty_Design, approved 2026-10-07, to build) shows the grey "-".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R2: “Each measure is calculated as defined in the table below.”
  • S3-R2 table row (Technician Efficiency): “| Technician Efficiency | Invoiced technician hours divided by clocked hours, times 100, for the selected range. Each work order line's technician time is split across the technicians who worked it, in proportion to each technician's share of the clocked time on that line. | Technician Efficiency report (Invoiced) |”
  • S3-E3: “Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization are each a ratio. When the denominator for the selected range is zero, worked hours, clocked hours, or the sum of work-order and internal hours, the measure has no value for that range. It is not zero, and the tile must not show "0.00%", because no hours recorded and a genuine zero percent are different facts. The same applies to the Revenue tile's parts-versus-labor split when revenue for the range is zero (S4-N2 already gives that tile its fallback supporting line). Inside the Technician Efficiency calculation, a work order line with invoiced technician time but no clocked time contributes no split share rather than an infinite one. The tile headline reads exactly "-", a single hyphen, in grey.”
  • S3-R1: “Every figure the dashboard shows for a measure equals the figure the measure's matching report shows for the same workplace, date range, and filters. This holds at every moment, not merely in principle. The dashboard may serve a figure from a cache, but only in a way that cannot produce a difference: the tile and its report must resolve to the same stored calculation, or the cache must be invalidated by the same events that change the report's answer. A tile that shows a different number from its report because one of them is more recently computed than the other is a defect, not an accepted staleness window. There is no freshness allowance and no "up to N minutes behind" in this spec.”
